profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, trading under the ticker SOUN, with SEC CIK 0001840856. Its website presents it as a provider of conversational AI agents for the real world, aimed at enterprise brands.

The company describes its OASYS platform as powering voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations. The site quotes customers saying that SoundHound's agentic AI lets them resolve more requests faster and scale operations, that its voice AI has helped franchisees process orders more efficiently and supported employees during peak hours, and that its hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity deliver always-on voice experiences.

The record held on the company lists no lawsuits and no tracked products or MCP servers. Delaware appears as the jurisdiction with the most recorded litigation exposure, at 33 cases.
